llm_response.reason: The site 'denimtearsnl.com' purports to be a luxury brand retailer for 'Ami Paris', but uses a domain name unrelated to the actual brand (which is 'amiparis.com'), thereby spoofing the legitimate company (scam characteristic #16). The domain is newly registered (June 27, 2025), uses privacy protection (often used to hide true ownership in scams), and contains no legitimate company or contact information (characteristics #4 and #6). All site links point to a further spoof domain ('ami-ca.com') and not the authentic brand site. These signals strongly indicate a Fake Online Shopping scam designed to steal payment or personal information.
